acceptanceCriteria.ac: Metric discovery: System can list all available metrics in financial_tables. Validation: Integration test for list_available_metrics()
Dynamic metric support: Forecasting works for any metric with 8+ data points. Validation: Unit test for arbitrary metric names
Insufficient data validation: Clear error when metric has <8 data points. Validation: Unit test for "Insufficient data" response
MCP tool updated: get_financial_forecast accepts any metric and validates availability. Validation: Integration test for available metrics on failure
Entity parameter removed: EBITDA forecasting works without entity disambiguation. Validation: Integration test for consolidated GROUP values
Validation test coverage: EBITDA and 2+ additional metrics in forecast accuracy tests. Validation: test_forecast_accuracy.py includes multiple metrics

doc.title: Epic 4 Retrospective
doc.snippet: Story 5.0.4: Enable forecasting for any financial metric found in documents, not just hardcoded revenue/cash_flow/expenses. Refactor time-series storage schema for dynamic metrics.

doc.title: Story 4.1: Time-Series Data Extraction
doc.snippet: Implementation of extract_timeseries_from_sql() and extract_timeseries() functions for extracting temporal financial metrics from documents.

doc.title: Story 4.10: Forecasting & Insights Test Suite
doc.snippet: ForecastAccuracyValidator with MAPE calculation, backtesting with 80/20 split. 14 tests validate ±15% threshold per NFR10. Extend for EBITDA scenarios.

doc.title: Non-Functional Requirements
doc.snippet: Forecast accuracy ±15% validated on historical data. 8+ data points minimum for reliable forecasting.

constraints.constraint: Anti-over-engineering: Keep solutions simple, ~600-800 line total codebase target. No custom wrappers, use SDKs directly.
Use existing MIN_DATA_POINTS=8 constant from hybrid.py. Don't introduce new thresholds.
All database operations must use SafetyGuard for production protection. Tests use port 6335/5433.
Unit tests for all new functions. Integration tests for MCP tool. Validation tests for metrics.
Follow ForecastAccuracyValidator pattern for new validation scenarios. Use MAPE/SMAPE for accuracy.

interface.name: MetricInfo
interface.signature: class MetricInfo(BaseModel): name: str, data_point_count: int, min_date: Optional[datetime], max_date: Optional[datetime], can_forecast: bool

interface.name: MetricValidationError
interface.signature: class MetricValidationError(Exception): metric_name, data_points_found, minimum_required, available_metrics

interface.name: ForecastQueryRequest.list_metrics
interface.signature: list_metrics: bool = Field(False, description="If True, return available metrics instead of forecast")

interface.name: ForecastQueryResponse.available_metrics
interface.signature: available_metrics: Optional[list[MetricInfo]] = Field(None, description="Available metrics on error or list_metrics=True")

tests.standards: Follow project testing patterns: pytest with pytest-asyncio for async tests, pytest-mock for mocking. Unit tests in tests/unit/, integration tests in tests/integration/, validation tests in tests/validation/. Use test database ports 6335 (Qdrant) and 5433 (PostgreSQL). Target 80%+ coverage on new code. Use @pytest.mark.asyncio for async tests. Validation tests use @pytest.mark.validation marker for CI control.
